Auth._doc: Mode 'Bypass' (default) enables /auth/dev-login with fake role users — no external IdP needed. Switch to 'Auth0' and fill the Auth0 section (or set env vars Auth__Mode=Auth0, Auth__Auth0__Domain, Auth__Auth0__ClientId, Auth__Auth0__ClientSecret) to activate the OIDC confidential-client flow.

Assistant._doc: AI portfolio Q&A. Requires the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable; without it the endpoint reports configured=false and the UI shows a setup hint.
